verificationSummary: Editor merge commit f45512f2667d066553b7ffaedfdc85d2c6e1392f implements the bounded Outline scannability foundation for the Editor left outline. OutlinePanel now renders an Outline summary, count by displayed outline item type, lucide type icons, data-outline-type, data-outline-depth, data-selected attributes, and clearer accessibility labels while preserving the existing onSelectNode selection path. Focused RED first failed in src/tests/outlineScannability.test.ts because OutlinePanel did not render an Outline summary or data-outline-type/depth cues. Focused GREEN passed npx vitest run src/tests/outlineScannability.test.ts --reporter verbose with 1 file and 2 tests. Editor worktree npm run check passed type-check, 90 passed test files, 310 passed tests, and build. Worktree browser evidence in live Backend mode opened http://127.0.0.1:50079/documents/product-report-vnext-minimal/design with Backend at http://127.0.0.1:50078, confirmed outlineVisible true, summaryLabel Outline summary, 3 items, Text 1, Columns 1, Table 1, item labels Product Report for Customer, Text block / Columns section / Table section, data-outline-type values text-block / columns / table, data-outline-depth 0 values for the served sample, summary-columns selected true after clicking Columns, and no browser errors. Merged Editor main npm run check passed type-check, 90 passed test files, 310 passed tests, and build. Main browser evidence at http://127.0.0.1:63958/documents/product-report-vnext-minimal/design with Backend at http://127.0.0.1:63957 confirmed the same Outline summary, item labels, selected summary-columns state, type/depth attributes, and 0 browser errors. Vite still reports the existing chunk-size warning. Editor npm install in the lane still reported 5 high severity vulnerabilities. Project Control baseline npm run check first failed with a transient Vitest worker startup timeout before any Project Control record edits; the immediate exact rerun passed check:data, type-check, 56 test files, 327 tests, build, and 6 e2e tests. Project Control worktree record gate npm run check passed check:data, type-check, 57 test files, 328 tests, build, and 6 e2e tests after records were added. git deregistered the Editor worktree and branch deletion succeeded, but the residual .worktrees/editor-outline-scannability-foundation folder could not be removed because ignored files remained in the physical folder. Previous residual Editor worktree folders for editor-inspector-detail-navigation-foundation and editor-selection-context-summary-foundation remain local cleanup risks. This evidence supports only the bounded Editor Outline scannability presentation layer and does not promote broad Editor truth, WYSIWYG readiness, text input readiness, command authoring readiness, Backend mutation or persistence readiness, Backend production readiness, Core truth, accessibility readiness, visual regression readiness, durable storage readiness, PDF export readiness, bundle-size readiness, live production behavior, or FlowDoc product readiness.
